summary: One deliberate fork deviation: the pointerdown guard must tolerate the merged toolbar's own 引用 button, otherwise pressing it would discard the pending quote before the click lands.

edits.why: The merged bundle renders the 引用 button inside the annotation host and triggers the plugin own click from there. Presses in that box (the action, the box background, the 批注 button) must not discard the pending excerpt, or pressing 引用 fails with its own "excerpt saved" notice; presses outside the box still dismiss as upstream intends.

A press with no pending excerpt used to return silently, so the merged toolbar could close its box with nothing inserted. It now shows the plugin own insert-failed notice, which also lets the glue keep the box open for a retry.

The chat auto-scrolls while the answer streams, and the plugin dropped its pending excerpt on any scroll. With the merged toolbar in charge (its marker is set) a scroll must keep the excerpt, otherwise pressing 引用 fails. Standalone mode keeps the upstream dismissal so the floating button never lingers at a stale position.

While the merged toolbar is in charge, a selection that momentarily cannot be resolved (the transcript re-renders under a live selection during streaming) must not discard the pending excerpt: the box stays up, so pressing 引用 then failed with the plugin own "excerpt saved" notice. Escape, outside presses and scrolls keep their meaning.
